scenario_ref: scenarios.md: Upgrade this installed plugin from N to N+1 and verify it still works.

agent.prompt: Use Develop to assess whether this selected upgrade needs mixed-version migration or irreversible-data recovery checks. Review only; use the supplied repository facts and report the applicable checks. Do not invent a deployment system or change files.

inputs.content:
# Selected upgrade
A local formatting tool changes from version N to N+1. It runs once, has no persisted application state, connection protocol, service, shared database, or overlap between versions. Its only output is a formatted text file. Existing acceptance checks compare formatting on representative inputs and confirm unchanged command arguments and exit codes. Source selection is authorized; installation and deployment are not.
